prerequisites: Publishing requires an authenticated hf CLI session with write access to an owner-supplied public dataset.
Owner HF Storage and R2 public archive URLs and write credentials were not supplied; a public sample does not verify an owner deployment.

dataset.meaning: Real public dataset archive pinned to discovered commit SHA; it is an MGRS grid, not a Protomaps basemap. Confirms hosting transport, not application schema compatibility.

r2.meaning: Official public R2 PMTiles sample. Chromium rendered real features, but Content-Range was not exposed to JavaScript; strict hosting gate failed.

hfStorage.searchResult: No indexed bucket PMTiles results; search relaxed to dataset repositories. Public documented bucket root exposes pi-logo-dark.svg, which was probed as a transport-only control.
hfStorage.meaning: HTTP transport passes on the discovered 473-byte SVG, but PMTiles parsing and tile rendering correctly fail. This is not evidence that an HF Storage PMTiles deployment works. A real owner-supplied PMTiles bucket object remains required.
hfStorage.versioning: Official docs describe HF Storage Buckets as mutable and non-versioned, unlike SHA-pinned dataset repositories.

protomapsSource.meaning: Reachable source for extraction, not a supported hotlink hosting deployment. Daily URL retention is finite.

publishing.meaning: No upload attempted and no production env written; owner repository and authenticated write access remain prerequisites.
